name: AmberX settings help
description: Help mode entries for the AmberX settings plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: AmberX settings
entries.text: The AmberX app's settings for every phone: voice, the axHub watch, links and quiet. They live on axHub, so each phone follows on its next settings refresh. Claude changes the same with amberx-settings_set, the CLI with axf amberx-settings set. The auto-approve switches change only here, in your own browser.

entries.title: One AmberX setting
entries.text: Opens AmberX settings on one setting (its key, like voice.lang).
